title: Electron desktop client
description: Drive an isolated Electron app through real CDP input against a running production gateway. Requires a dedicated validation profile, gateway, project and slot; never use the operator's gateway.

desktop-client.intent: Reject an invalid credential, save a valid connection, display its fleet, create and delete a backlog item through Electron with gateway-side assertions, load source and an authenticated image, start a bundled Monaco worker, resize the terminal and execute keystrokes with a file receipt, check synthetic H.264 rendering compatibility, then reconnect using the saved credential. Synthetic video does not prove live device transport.
